title: Guise? to the duc de Mercœur, 27 May and 20 June 1587, BnF fr. 15564 ff. 119 and 142 (DECODE R4162, R4165)

steps.what: Fetched DECODE R4162/R4165 metadata with the saved cookie: they are fr. 15564 ff. 119 and 142.
cryptiana GL.htm: Lasry's 2022 key covers ff. 27, 78, 119, 142; downloaded the key table and his f. 27 decipherment image.
Located f. 119 (view 132) and f. 142 (view 155) on Gallica and fetched full-resolution crops.
First-pass glyph-label transcription of f. 142's 16 cipher lines (574 signs).
Seeded simulated annealing, one letter per label, fr-1600-letters 5-gram: drifted to pseudo-French because labels merge distinct key signs.
Closing formula 'vous baise tres humblement les mains' fixed A, U, M, T, R signs.
Beam search with per-label candidate sets from the key: most of f. 142 comes out as French.
Word-by-word reading of f. 142 from zoomed line images (f142_reading.txt).
f. 119 cut into 44 line images; transcription and reading by two agents with the confirmed sign list (AGENT_BRIEF.md).
Beam search with widened candidate sets and 5-gram LM (bl2.py): recovers conservation, conciliation, ferme fondement, cinq cens hommes.
Refinement pass found label corrections y=D, 8=M/N, k=A/I, U=X/R, 6=N, %=G/P; decode rerun (f119_beam3.txt).
Hand re-reading of lines 00-04, 12-14, 19, 21-22 at higher zoom; f. 119 at ~70% of signs, f. 142 ~85%.
About twenty line-by-line relabelling passes at 2x zoom with pinned letters, three lines per agent, on both letters.
Key extended in this hand: y=D/de, ✝=Q, ɤ=D/T/X, x-shape=Y/N, 3=C/D, 8=M/B/N/T, dotted Є=R, k=A, =ʃ=P.
Candidate-class phrase search over French corpora for the last unread runs (iusques icy, arrester, cherchions, faisant estat, en quoy, defaire).
Measured: f. 119 1861 signs 84 unread; f. 142 623 signs 44 unread (7 code groups); 95.1% of letter signs read.

outcome.fraction_read_source: f119_reading.txt and f142_pinned.txt: '|| total unread' per line; code groups counted separately

gaps.detail: tried in three rounds plus phrase search; some look like code pairs

gaps.item: name codes 21, 43, 71, 73, N, &, 9b, ffv, ffσ, ffx, ffou

outcome.notes: Lasry published the key (2022) but no plaintext; both letters read here for the first time as far as found.

prior.where: George Lasry's key table (2022) on cryptiana GL.htm names ff. 119 and 142 among the letters it solves; no plaintext published; DECODE records still 'Non-decrypted'.
